paragraphs: From: Sara Pedrazzini, Pro Senectute Ticino, Bellinzona office
To: claims inbox
Subject: Theft at the flat of Mrs Ines Bernasconi, policy 7720-0041
Good morning,
I am the social worker responsible for Mrs Ines Bernasconi (88), Via Lugano 19, Bellinzona, and I write with her written authorisation, which I attach.
Mrs Bernasconi spent three weeks in a rehabilitation clinic after a hip operation.
When her niece went to the flat on 14 July 2026 to air it, she found the balcony door open, the lock pried and the bedroom and living room searched.
The police in Bellinzona took the report the same day.
An identified building contractor caused the loss and their identity is known.

According to the niece, a fur coat, a collection of Capodimonte porcelain figurines and a small jewellery box are missing, among other things; Mrs Bernasconi herself has not been home yet and cannot say exactly what else is gone.
No bicycle or e-bike is among the stolen items.
No stolen item is separately scheduled in the policy with an insured value of CHF 1,000 or more.
The niece has also confirmed the following to me: No SIM card was stolen and no loss from SIM-card misuse is claimed.
Mrs Bernasconi asked me to add that she has always paid her premiums and hopes the matter can be settled simply.
Neither party has requested the formal expert determination procedure.
No repair costing more than CHF 500 is contemplated for the damaged insured items.
Regarding your company: The insurer has not declined the claim for indemnity.
The insurer has not sent a written demand setting a document deadline under a forfeiture warning.
None of the stolen items has been recovered and no news of them has been received.
Mrs Bernasconi returns home next week.
Please send any letters to her with a copy to me, as she has difficulty reading small print.
Kind regards,
Sara Pedrazzini
